newsitem.title: USA: Montgomery seeks to sell 10 pct stake - Barron's.
newsitem.headline: Montgomery seeks to sell 10 pct stake - Barron's.

text.p: Brokerage firm Montgomery Securities is seeking to sell a 10 percent stake to an outside investor in a bid to shore up its capital levels and provide for future growth, according to the May 19 issue of Barron's.
The article said that Montgomery chief executive Tom Weisel has been holding discussions with potential bidders for the past six months.

It said that while Weisel did not disclose the names of the buyers, he told the journal that the privately held brokerage could be interested in joining hands with a bank "with the lending capability that could help our equity clients grow".
The story speculates that two contenders could be NationsBank Corp and First Union Corp, both of which are seeking to expand their exposure in the securities business.
Investment bankers familiar with the situation say that Montgomery could raise at least $100 million by selling a 10 percent stake, Barron's reported.
